actions.action: Nudge base to check if plant wiggles in bark (root anchoring check)
Inspect crown and spike for cracks or bruising
Place clear pot into heavier ceramic/glass cachepot with stones in bottom
Empty water from cachepot or saucer after watering
Push stake to bottom, press bark firmly, and clip/tie base to stake
Rotate pot so leaves point opposite the flower arch
Re-clip spike more upright along stake
Water by soaking and draining when roots turn silvery-green (every 7-10 days)

reason: The answer identifies top-heaviness and an unstable pot as the main problem, and its first fix, placing the pot inside a heavier outer pot, matches what worked; nothing it suggests is harmful.
